messages:
jess_support: Hey team — ACME reported that after the org billing import their project admins can no longer access the project console, seeing 403s. Can someone pick this up?

mike_csm: Pinged ACME, they said it was working before the CSV import around 10:03 UTC. I’ve got their admin user (acme-admin) who can reproduce.

acme-admin: Confirming — I click into Projects → MyProject and the console shows "Permission denied (403)". I can list org projects via API but console buttons are grayed out.

jess_support: Thanks. Can you paste the browser error/network log and an example API call that returns 403?

acme-admin: API sample: `GET https://api.redwood.example/v1/projects/myproject` header `Authorization: Bearer sk-live-REDACTED` returns 403 and body `{"error":"forbidden","reason":"project_console:access_denied"}`.

ryan_infra: Looking at org-sync-bot logs for the import window (10:00–10:06). I see a batch that attached legacy_iam_tag = "legacy-admin" to several identities, then a follow-up normalization job removed that tag mapping. Suspicious.

org-sync-bot: import-job(3265432059): processed 1,243 SCIM rows; added tags: [legacy-admin, finance-readonly]

org-sync-bot: normalize-job(3265432078): collapsed tag alias legacy_admin -> legacy-admin; removed redundant mappings 87 entries

olivia_engineer: Quick hypothesis: our console access checks still evaluate an older tag-based allowlist (legacy-admin) that got lost during alias normalization, leaving policy without any positive grant for those identities.

jess_support: Can we confirm whether the affected users still have an account role binding on the project?

ryan_infra: Querying permissions store for acme-admin... result: no project-level rolebindings. Org-level binding exists but has meta tag = "legacy-admin" which no longer maps to an effective permission due to the normalization mismatch.

olivia_engineer: Repro steps I used locally: 1) Create rolebinding with tag legacy-admin at org scope, 2) run alias-normalize job, 3) UI check → console shows grayed controls and API GET returns 403. So bug reproduced.

jess_support: Proposed short-term mitigation: re-add a direct project-level admin binding for affected users (workaround for ACME) and queue a rollback of the normalization change.

mike_csm: ACME asked for a fast workaround. I can create the project-level binding if infra/engineers confirm it's safe.

ryan_infra: I can add the binding. Command we’ll run: `POST /internal/admin/projects/myproject/rolebindings` body `{ "principal":"user:acme-admin","role":"project.admin","source":"support-mitigation" }` — will log audit and is reversible.

olivia_engineer: I’ll prepare a patch to the normalization logic so that alias collapse preserves at least one canonical mapping until downstream policy rules are rebuilt. Also adding a short integration test.

deploy-bot: staging-deploy queued for branch fix/iam-normalize at 3265432130. Estimated deploy in 12m.

jess_support: Action items: Ryan — apply project binding for ACME now. Olivia — push PR to keep alias mapping safe and add test. Mike — confirm with ACME once Ryan completes. I’ll document escalation in the ticket.

ryan_infra: Applied binding and audit log shows entry created (audit_id: audit-89f4). ACME, can you test console now?

acme-admin: Confirmed: console access restored, admin controls visible. Thanks.

mike_csm: Relaying to ACME that we’ll follow up with a permanent fix and a post-mortem. They asked to include timeline and whether any other orgs could be affected.

olivia_engineer: I’ll run a targeted scan for other orgs that had alias normalization events in the same window and flag any with rolebindings that reference collapsed tags. Expect a report in ~45m.

jess_support: Great. Marking this thread resolved for customer. Root cause summary to include in PM: alias normalization removed canonical mapping for legacy tag used by org-level rolebindings, leaving console policy without a grant — caused project-level 403. Workaround: re-add explicit project binding; fix: preserve mapping during normalization + tests + runbackfill check.

olivia_engineer: Note for post-mortem: add monitor to detect sudden increases in org->project console 403 rates (threshold: >50/hr) and alert on alias-normalize runs.

deploy-bot: prod-deploy scheduled for fix/iam-normalize at 3265432600 pending approvals.

jess_support: Thanks everyone. I’ll close once post-mortem doc is linked. :white_check_mark:
